name: Tier 11 (UIV)
description:
Now that you've enjoyed your exotic cookies, let's keep going, shall we?

Welcome to Insanely Ultimate Voltage, a very fun tier with many new large multiblocks to play with! At first, this tier is mainly about solving your DTPF catalyst problems and getting to Eternal Coils. Afterward, you are introduced to late game content like the Forge of the Gods, the Bose-Einstein Condensate Apparatus, and the Black Hole Compressor that you will use until the end of the modpack!

This tier also introduces a few QoL additions, like the Crafting Input Proxy, Uncertainty Resolver, and the Thaumometric Essentia Cell.

You also gain access to the Dyson Swarm and the Semi-Stable Antimatter Stabilization Sequencer, two incredibly powerful ways to generate power.
